card.line: Hebron is an ancient city in Judah's hill country where Abraham lived and buried Sarah, Caleb received his inheritance, and David first became king.

moments.title: Abram Settles at Hebron
moments.text: Abram moved his tent to live near the Oaks of Mamre at Hebron. There he built an altar to the LORD.

moments.title: Sarah Dies at Hebron
moments.text: Sarah died in Kiriath-arba, which is Hebron. Abraham mourned for her and then asked the Hittites for a burial site.

moments.title: Caleb Receives Hebron
moments.text: Caleb reminded Joshua of Moses' promise. Joshua blessed Caleb and gave him Hebron, because Caleb wholly followed the LORD.

moments.title: David Made King of Judah
moments.text: David asked the LORD where to go, and the LORD said, "To Hebron." The men of Judah came there and anointed him king over Judah.

moments.title: David Made King of Israel
moments.text: All the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron. The elders made a covenant with him before the LORD and anointed him king over Israel.
